title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 90
description: Ten questions on Psalms 90: the eternal Lord, the shortness of human life, and a prayer to count our days.

questions.text: What does verse 1 say the Lord has been for all generations?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says: "Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations."

questions.text: According to verse 2, God is God from before the birth of what?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says: "Before the mountains were born... from everlasting to everlasting, you are God."

questions.text: What are a thousand years like in God's sight?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.

answers.text: A drop in the great sea

questions.text: What has happened to the new grass by evening?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says: "In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry."

answers.text: It has been eaten by cattle

questions.text: Where has God set our secret sins, according to verse 8?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says God has set our secret sins in the light of his presence.

answers.text: In a sealed book of records
In the depths of the sea
In the light of his presence

questions.text: How do we bring our years to an end, according to verse 9?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says: "We bring our years to an end as a sigh."

questions.text: The days of our years are seventy, or by reason of strength how many?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says the days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years.

questions.text: Why does the psalmist ask God to teach us to count our days?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says: "So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom."

answers.text: That we may live a long life
That we may gather great riches
That we may see our children's children
That we may gain a heart of wisdom

questions.text: With what does the psalmist ask God to satisfy us in the morning?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says: "Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness."

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask God to establish, at the end of the psalm?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says: "Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands."
